members: GStaticMP::GetCharacterInfo@0x141010EC0: `*(_QWORD *)(this + 19568) + 232LL * characterIndex`; ctor stores characterInfo here
GStaticMP::HasCharacterInfo@0x141010FD0: `a2 < (signed int)a1->m_characterCount` reads +19576; ctor stores maxPlayers here
GStaticMP::GetCharacterInfo@0x141010EC0: `characterIndex >= *(_DWORD *)(this + 19580)` reads +19580; ctor stores characterCount here
structs.notes: Builder size 19592 is not supported: the extra 8 bytes came from the ctor arguments being named crosswise (maxPlayers -> m_characterCount, characterCount -> m_playerCount); offsets 19576/19580 match game-test by name. Outside this struct: the ctor memsets the characterInfo array with 13720 * maxPlayers (13720 = characterInfo_t stride candidate), and GetCharacterInfo strides m_playerEvents by 232, which the GPlayerEventsMP ctor loop also uses (`add rdi, 0E8h`).
